Go to the "Nemakati" (Recruitment) section on the homepage.
Download the prescribed application form for the Elephant Kavadiga post.
Fill the application legibly in English (capital letters) or Kannada only, and affix a recent passport-size photograph.

Government/other government servants already drawing a salary from Central/State Government or PSU service are not eligible to apply. Candidates found to be members of, or in close contact with, an organisation declared unlawful will not be eligible for appointment. Selected candidates must serve a minimum probation period of 2 years from the date of joining under the Conservator of Forests of the concerned circle. content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Forest Department has issued five separate notifications - one for each circle - for direct recruitment to Group 'D' Elephant Kavadiga posts for the year 2026-27, under the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules, 2009. All five notifications are dated 27 July 2026 and follow common eligibility, age, and selection rules, with the same application period. content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Vacancy Details 2026 (Circle-Wise)
content_sections.text: A combined total of 57 Elephant Kavadiga posts are available across the five circles - 51 posts approved as fresh vacancies and 6 posts carried forward as backlog vacancies from an earlier 2022-23 recruitment cycle. The circle-wise and division-wise break-up is given below. Note: Within each circle's General/reserved-category allocation, horizontal reservation also applies for Ex-servicemen, Women, Persons with Disability, Project-Displaced persons, candidates who studied in Kannada medium, Rural candidates, and Third Gender candidates, as detailed in each circle's individual notification. One vacancy in the Mysuru circle's SC category (marked with an asterisk in the source notification) is subject to a pending court order on reservation percentages, dated 25 May 2026.

content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold Indian citizenship (or fall under specific categories of persons of Indian origin who migrated with the intention of permanently settling in India, as defined in the notification). Candidates must be residing within a notified forest area under the jurisdiction of the Karnataka Forest Department, within Karnataka state. Candidates must be able to speak and understand Kannada. Experience in elephant management/handling is mandatory for this post. The notifications do not specify a separate minimum educational qualification; the application form itself only asks candidates to declare their number of years of experience in handling elephants - it does not require submission of educational certificates. A male candidate who has a living spouse and marries again without obtaining prior permission from the Government is not eligible for appointment. Candidates must be mentally and physically healthy, and their physical condition must not come in the way of efficiently discharging the duties of the post. Candidates against whom a complete inquiry into a criminal case is pending, or who have been convicted, are not eligible for appointment, per the process outlined in the notification.

content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed a minimum of 18 years of age as on the last date for submission of applications. Age is reckoned as on the last date of application, i.e., 03 September 2026. A one-time additional relaxation of 5 years in the maximum age limit has been extended to candidates of all categories participating in backlog recruitment notified up to 31 December 2027, per Government Order No. CiaSau 262 Senani 2025, dated 29 January 2026. Ex-servicemen are entitled to age relaxation equal to the number of years of armed forces service actually rendered, plus 3 years, subject to their overall eligibility for the post under their category.

content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Reservation (Vertical & Horizontal)
content_sections.text: Vacancies in each circle are reserved category-wise (Vertical Reservation: General/SC/ST/Category-I/Category-IIA/Category-IIB/Category-IIIA/Category-IIIB) as well as reservation-type-wise (Horizontal Reservation: Ex-servicemen, Women, Persons with Disability, Project-Displaced persons, Kannada-medium candidates, Rural candidates, and Third Gender candidates). Persons with Disability reservation has not been extended for this post specifically, since the Elephant Kavadiga role is not identified as suitable for PwD candidates as per Government Notification No. DPAR/52/SRR/99, dated 08.12.2002; the PwD reservation point is instead adjusted into the General (Others) category under horizontal reservation.

content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for this recruitment. The application form itself states that no fee is payable and that no supporting documents need to be enclosed at the time of initial application submission.

content_sections.heading: KFD Elephant Kavadiga Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made purely through an interview and a performance assessment - there is no written examination for this post. Candidates are assessed on their ability to speak and comprehend Kannada, and on their practical experience and performance capability in elephant handling. The interview and performance assessment together carry a maximum of 100 marks. Based on the marks obtained and the category-wise vacancy position, a provisional select list is prepared and published on the official website, followed by a final select list after considering any objections. Candidates not present on the specified date and time for the interview/performance test will not be permitted to appear later, and the scheduled date will not be changed for any candidate. The interview/performance assessment process may be video-recorded or covered by CCTV, with the footage retained as backup for transparency.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for KFD Elephant Kavadiga Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: No documents need to be attached with the initial application form. However, candidates called for interview/document verification must carry original documents along with self-attested photocopies, including: Proof of experience in elephant management, issued by the concerned Range Forest Officer or an officer senior to that rank Proof of residence within the notified forest area, issued by the concerned Tehsildar (for candidates residing within a forest area notified across Karnataka state) Proof of date of birth (birth certificate/school leaving certificate/Aadhaar card) Caste certificate in the prescribed format, for candidates claiming category reservation Non-Creamy Layer certificate (valid for 5 years from issue), for candidates belonging to Category-I/IIA/IIB/IIIA/IIIB claiming reservation One valid photo ID proof - any one of Aadhaar Card, Passport, Driving Licence, PAN Card, a government/PSU photo Service ID Card, a bank passbook with photograph, registered property documents with photograph, a community certificate with photograph, an Ex-servicemen's pension book/pension payment order, or a Vikasit Bharat - Employment and Livelihood Guarantee Mission (Gramin) job card with photograph Domicile/nativity certificate confirming residence within Karnataka state, where applicable
